about: Airport rules for OnBoard Disruption Recovery: time zones, minimum connection times (MCT), gate closing and nearby airports.
Read by the backend (connection.FileAirportRulesProvider) and, from phase C3, bundled in the app. Shape: recovery-core/src/main/java/com/safarsaathi/recovery/rules/.

Every number says what it is: kind OFFICIAL (from an official page: sourceUrl + lastChecked), DEMO_VALUE (set by the team because nothing official is public; the app always says 'demo value') or ESTIMATE (team estimate; the app says 'estimate').
An airport with no connectionRules is fine: its connections show UNKNOWN. Never fill in a number you can't source; add a DEMO_VALUE only with the team's agreement.
nearbyAirports: only with a sourced ground transfer time (no invented distances).
The backend refuses to start when this file breaks a rule (AirportRules.problems()), and a test checks it.

transfer.source: Team estimate, not an official figure

gateClose.source: Team estimate, not an airline figure: the boarding pass shows the real gate-closing time

defaults.atRiskMarginNote: Product choice, not a fact: meeting the minimum with less than 15 minutes to spare is shown as 'at risk'.
